description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It is used to configure menu screens related to employee timesheets within the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for employee timesheets by overriding the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet', implementing the MenuConfigurator interface and using helper traits.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' within the module, returning null as it does not produce a menu item directly.
